title: Machine learning identifies a candidate NEC expression signature with experimental checks
summary: RF+XGBoost screening identified SLC26A3, CCL20 and CXCL5 as a candidate expression signature for neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis, with retrospective expression validation and new mouse and cell-model expression checks. The study used 46 training and 24 test samples; the reported 0.979 AUC is training performance, with 0.917 and 0.957 in two small test cohorts. Geneformer and virtual-knockout analyses generated regulatory hypotheses; causality, protein-level diagnostic performance and clinical benefit remain unestablished.

source_review.scope: Primary full paper Methods, Results and limitations plus Europe PMC bibliographic metadata;reviewed 2026-11-21.

evidence.tested: Mouse and cell-model expression checks corroborated candidate-gene directions; diagnostic evaluation used retrospective human datasets.
evidence.unknown: Clinical diagnostic utility, causal regulatory interactions and treatment efficacy remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: RF+XGBoost screening links expression data to three NEC candidate genes; 46 training and24 independent retrospective test samples.
